newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms RANK long, short-term ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms RANK long, short-term ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Tuesday it had affirmed its A minus long-term and A1 short-term ratings for The Rank Group Plc.
Rank owns a diversity of businesses across complementary market sectors, backed by a significant asset base, IBCA said in a statement.

"The company remains the UK's largest leisure and entertainment group and the restructuring announced in August, which included the reorganisation of its four major divisions, will simplify the corporate structure," it said.

"The sale of Rank's 40 percent interest in Rank Xerox in 1995 and the 300 million sterling disposal programme announced earlier this year should enable Rank to finance its ongoing investment programme."
IBCA said Rank's major acquisitions in 1996 have included the remaining cafes and brand rights of Hard Rock not already owned by Rank, and the independent pub chain, Tom Cobleigh.

"Capital expenditure plans have been scaled back and although Rank still plans an integrated leisure complex adjacent to Universal Studios Florida, further openings of large bingo clubs and construction of more multi-activity leisure centres and the development of Oasis Holiday Villages may not be as rapid," it said.
"High debt levels built up on earlier acquisitions have been reduced steadily. Although debt levels may increase, the realisation of the disposals programme will restrain gearing," IBCA added.
